records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue generated through indirect distribution channels accounted for approximately 90% of total revenues in both the three months ended June 30, 2025 and 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: ▪The increase in Americas total revenues was primarily due to increases of 16% and 82% in term-based license and SaaS revenues, respectively, partially offset by a 37% decrease in perpetual license revenue, driven by the shift from selling perpetual licenses to subscription software arrangements.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: –Net cash provided by operating activities was impacted by net income adjusted for the impact of non-cash charges and a decrease in accrued expenses, partially offset by an increase in deferred revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To the extent the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, the translation of these foreign currency denominated transactions generally results in increased revenues, operating expenses and income from operations for our non-U.S. operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: –Net cash provided by investing activities was the result of $34.8 million of net proceeds from the sale of Commvault's corporate headquarters, partially offset by $6.1 million for the purchase of equity securities and $1.9 million of capital expenditures.
